design.fresh_start_semantics: one torchrun process group per start; every start reloads all immutable artifacts and rebuilds weights before warmup
design.response_definition: start-level Q = mean of four paired block effects; each block effect is completion_fenced_us_per_forward(identity) - completion_fenced_us_per_forward(candidate)

timing.diagnostic_metric: same-device CUDA elapsed interval bracketing real runner.run
timing.schedule_algorithm: random.Random(seed + offset + block).shuffle over the frozen layout order; offset 0 for the primary pass, 1000003 for the diagnostic pass
